NCBI E-utilities REST API

The Entrez E-utilities are a set of server-side programs that provide a stable interface into the Entrez query and database system at the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI).

Base URL: https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/

EInfo — Database Statistics

Provides a list of all valid Entrez databases and their statistics.

Endpoint: GET /einfo.fcgi

Parameters:

  • db — target database (optional; omit to list all)
  • retmode — output format: json or xml

Example:

GET /einfo.fcgi?db=pubmed&retmode=json

ESearch — Text Search

Search any Entrez database for a text query and retrieve matching UIDs.

Endpoint: GET /esearch.fcgi

Parameters:

  • db — target database (required)
  • term — search term (required)
  • retmax — max records to return (default 20)
  • usehistory — y to post results to history server

ESummary — Document Summaries

Returns document summaries for a list of primary IDs.

Endpoint: GET /esummary.fcgi

Parameters:

  • db — target database (required)
  • id — comma-delimited list of UIDs (required)
  • retmode — output format

EFetch — Full Records

Returns formatted data records for a list of UIDs.

Endpoint: GET /efetch.fcgi

Parameters:

  • db — target database (required)
  • id — comma-delimited list of UIDs (required)
  • rettype — retrieval type (e.g. abstract, medline)
  • retmode — output format

ELink — Linked Records

Returns UIDs from a target database that are linked to UIDs in a source database.

Endpoint: GET /elink.fcgi

Parameters:

  • dbfrom — source database (required)
  • db — target database (required)
  • id — comma-delimited list of source UIDs (required)

EPost — Post UIDs to History

Posts a file containing a list of UIDs to the Entrez history server.

Endpoint: POST /epost.fcgi

Parameters (form body):

  • db — target database (required)
  • id — comma-delimited list of UIDs (required)

EGQuery — Global Search

Performs a text search in all Entrez databases and returns the number of hits.

Endpoint: GET /egquery.fcgi

Parameters:

  • term — search term (required)

ESpell — Spelling Suggestions

Retrieves spelling suggestions for a text query in a given database.

Endpoint: GET /espell.fcgi

Parameters:

  • db — target database (required)
  • term — query term (required)
